messages:
micah: Heads up — deploybot just put the canary rollout on HOLD for release v3.7.4. P95 latency crossed SLO by ~120ms and error-rate up 0.8% on east-1 canary. Need quick decision: manual rollback, automated revert, or tighten routing?

deploybot: [AUTOMATED] Canary hold triggered at 2026-03-21T09:12:01Z. Metrics: p95_latency=420ms (SLO=300ms), error_rate=1.8% (+0.8%). Suggested action: PAUSE + STAGGERED_UNWIND. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/canary-hold

sara: :eyes: I saw the spike. Do we have any customer-facing errors in logs?

jamal: Quick check — most errors are 502s from grpc-proxy on gpu pool. Could be new kernel flag. If it's kernel-related, rollback to v3.7.3 is safest.

micah: Agreed. Prefer manual, staged rollback to avoid flapping. Proposal: pin traffic to v3.7.3 for critical routes, then 50% canary rollback for 15m, then full rollback if p95 still >SLO.

lina: Can someone update release-notes and the incident channel with the pin and customer impact note? I'll prep a short comms draft.

opsbot: Suggested rollback commands:
```
# pin critical-route to previous model
routingctl pin --route critical-route --version v3.7.3 --duration 2h
# staged canary unwind
deployctl rollback --release v3.7.4 --target v3.7.3 --scope canary --stagger 10% --wait 15m
```

deploybot: If you want me to run those, approve with `:thumbsup:` and include `--manual-approve` in the command. Automated fallback will keep hold if no ops ack in 10m.

sara: I approve manual rollback. :thumbsup: micah, can you do the pin? I'll run the staged rollback once pinned.

micah: Doing pin now.
micah: `routingctl pin --route critical-route --version v3.7.3 --duration 2h` ✅

micah: Pinned. Notifying customers: "We temporarily routed traffic to a stable version due to elevated latency for a recent rollout. Investigating; will update in 30m."

jamal: Kicking off staged rollback:
`deployctl rollback --release v3.7.4 --target v3.7.3 --scope canary --stagger 10% --wait 15m --manual-approve`

deploybot: Rollback started. 10% traffic shifted. Telemetry will report in 150s.

opsbot: During the 15m window, watch p95 and grpc-502 counts. If p95 drops under 300ms and errors trend down, continue to 50% then 100%. If not, abort and escalate to infra team.

lina: Draft comms posted to #incidents and customer-notify doc updated (shortlink: /d/CK1X2). I'm tagging support for customer banners.

micah: Thanks — after the 15m check, let's reconvene here. If anyone sees unexpected customer impact immediately ping me and @oncall.

sara: Got it. Monitoring now.

deploybot: [UPDATE] 15m check: p95=305ms (improved), error_rate dropped to +0.2%. Recommend continue staged unwind to 50%.

micah: Proceed to 50% then 100% following the same stagger. Keep the pin for 2h for rollback safety and to give infra a window to triage kernel flags.

jamal: Noted — opening an infra ticket with logs and kernel flag diff.

micah: Closing loop: manual rollback executed, pin in place, comms sent. We will follow up with a postmortem if root cause requires a revert or patch. :white_check_mark:
